# Octavo Fuego — Rapé do Acre

## About
Octavo Fuego is a Colombian-based ecommerce store specializing in Rapé do Acre — a traditional Amazonian sacred snuff (rape) made from handcrafted medicinal tobacco and tree ashes. Sourced directly from indigenous communities in Acre, Brazilian Amazon.

## Products
- **Rapé (Rapé do Acre)**: 5 varieties — Kaxinawá, Nukini, Apurinã, Kuntanawa, Katukina. Available in 10g, 20g, 30g sizes.
- **Sananga**: Amazonian eye drops
- **Kuripes / Kuripe**: Traditional self-application pipes
